hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that fully intercepts swaps in beforeSwap, routing trades through Euler Finance lending vaults. It computes quotes via a proprietary curve invariant, deposits input tokens into the appropriate Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the counterpart vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting itself.
